title: Deterministic QA stage lifecycle
description: Add a persisted local QA report with explicit review controls after an approved preview render.
businessContext: Editors need concrete, traceable production risks before CapCut Draft or packaging; QA must never fabricate findings or approve downstream work automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: QA reports deterministic checks with evidence and severity, without fake AI findings.
QA inputs are only approved workflow artifacts and project data.
Run/list/approve/reject IPC is typed, persisted, and does not automatically approve the project.
Blocking findings prevent QA approval and therefore downstream export.
verificationCommands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/domain/test/ipcSchemas.test.ts
humanEscalationConditions: A required QA check needs unapproved upstream data.
A QA finding would require exposing secret material or absolute paths in renderer output.
